/ARCHETYPE — Project Archetype Generator

## Path resolution

Before any file operation, read `.nezam/core/gates/hardlock-paths.json` and resolve:
- `intake.prd`          → default `docs/plan/00-define/01-product/PRD.md`
- `planning.plansRoot`  → default `docs/plan/`
- `planning.changelog`  → default `.nezam/CHANGELOG.md`

All path references below use these resolved values.

---

## Subcommands

```
/ARCHETYPE                             → Interactive picker: choose archetype + services
/ARCHETYPE <type>                      → Scaffold directly (e.g. /ARCHETYPE saas-platform)
/ARCHETYPE <type> --services=<list>    → Scaffold + configure specific services
/ARCHETYPE <type> --services=all       → Scaffold + configure every applicable service
/ARCHETYPE status                      → Show current archetype + page inventory
/ARCHETYPE pages                       → List generated page specs
/ARCHETYPE gates                       → Run hardlock validation only
```

**Supported types:**
`landing-page` · `saas-platform` · `micro-saas` · `saas-xplatform` · `blog` · `cms` · `store` · `multivendor` · `portfolio` · `dashboard-app`

**Supported services:**
`github` · `supabase` · `prisma` · `vercel` · `stripe` · `resend` · `posthog` · `sentry` · `aws` · `clerk`

---

## Pre-flight check (every /ARCHETYPE invocation)

Read the following before proceeding:

1. **Hardlock paths** — `.nezam/core/gates/hardlock-paths.json`
2. **PRD** — resolved `intake.prd` path
3. **DESIGN.md** — repo root `DESIGN.md` (profile must be applied)
4. **AGENT_REGISTRY** — `.cursor/state/AGENT_REGISTRY.yaml`
5. **Workspace paths** — `.nezam/workspace.paths.yaml`

Show a pre-flight table before scaffolding:

```
/ARCHETYPE Pre-flight

  PRD             ✅ docs/plan/00-define/01-product/PRD.md
  DESIGN.md       ✅ Profile "Minimal Pro" applied
  Phase gate      ✅ Phase 01 (requirements) passed
  Handoff queue   ✅ No pending handoffs
  Archetype       → saas-platform
  Services        → github, supabase, prisma, vercel, stripe, resend
```

If any gate fails, show ❌ and block execution. Suggest `/START gates` to fix.

## Execution workflow

### Phase 1 — Spawn architecture swarm

Select agents based on archetype complexity:

```yaml
archetype: saas-platform       # or whichever was selected
swarm: swarm-1                 # Architecture tier
agents:
  - lead-solution-architect    # Owns the decision log
  - lead-backend-architect     # API + DB
  - lead-frontend-architect    # Next.js App Router structure
  - lead-database-architect    # Schema + migrations
  - lead-uiux-designer         # Page sections + wireframe handoff
  - project-architect          # Spec synthesis
  - spec-writer                # Produces page specs
```

Lightweight archetypes (landing-page, portfolio, blog) use a reduced swarm:
`lead-frontend-architect` · `lead-uiux-designer` · `spec-writer`

---

### Phase 2 — Generate page inventory

Write one spec file per page into `docs/plan/04-arch/pages/<group>/`.

**Group mapping per archetype:**

| Archetype | Groups |
|-----------|--------|
| landing-page | marketing |
| saas-platform | marketing · app · auth · legal |
| micro-saas | marketing · app · auth · legal |
| saas-xplatform | marketing · app · auth · legal · mobile |
| blog | marketing · posts |
| cms | marketing · cms-admin · auth |
| store | marketing · shop · account · auth · legal |
| multivendor | marketing · shop · vendor · account · auth · legal |
| portfolio | marketing |
| dashboard-app | app · auth |

**SaaS Platform full page list (reference):**

```
docs/plan/04-arch/pages/
├── marketing/
│   ├── landing.md          # Hero · Features · Pricing preview · CTA
│   ├── features.md         # Feature showcase · demos
│   ├── pricing.md          # 3-tier cards · comparison table
│   ├── about.md            # Company · team
│   └── contact.md          # Form · map
├── app/
│   ├── dashboard.md        # Stats · activity · quick actions
│   ├── analytics.md        # Charts · filters · exports
│   ├── settings.md         # Hub page
│   ├── settings-profile.md
│   ├── settings-billing.md
│   └── settings-security.md
├── auth/
│   ├── login.md
│   ├── register.md
│   ├── forgot-password.md
│   └── verify-email.md
└── legal/
    ├── privacy.md
    ├── terms.md
    └── cookies.md
```

Each spec file must include:
- **Route** — Next.js App Router path
- **Layout group** — `(marketing)` / `(app)` / `(auth)`
- **Sections** — ordered list with description
- **Protected** — `true` / `false`
- **SEO** — title · description · OG

### Phase 4 — Frontend scaffold

**Invoke skill:** `.cursor/skills/frontend/`

Generate Next.js App Router structure at `src/app/`:

```
src/
├── app/

│   │   ├── page.tsx          # Landing

│   │   ├── layout.tsx        # Sidebar + header
│   │   ├── dashboard/page.tsx
│   │   ├── analytics/page.tsx

│   │       ├── profile/page.tsx
│   │       ├── billing/page.tsx
│   │       └── security/page.tsx

│   │   ├── login/page.tsx
│   │   ├── register/page.tsx
│   │   └── forgot-password/page.tsx
```

### Phase 6 — Service configuration

Run only the services requested via `--services=`. For each:

#### `github`
- Branch protection: require PR + tests + 1 approval on `main`
- Workflows: `ci.yml` (lint · test · build) · `deploy.yml` · `semantic-release.yml`

#### `supabase`
- Auth providers: email · google · github · magic-link
- Storage buckets: avatars · uploads · public-assets
- RLS: enable on all user-scoped tables
- Generate SQL migration at `supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql`

#### `prisma`
Generate `prisma/schema.prisma` with: `User` · `Account` · `Session` · `VerificationToken` · (archetype extras: `Subscription`, `Organization`, etc.)

#### `vercel`
Generate `vercel.json`:
```json
{
  "buildCommand": "pnpm build",
  "devCommand": "pnpm dev",
  "installCommand": "pnpm install",
  "framework": "nextjs",
  "regions": ["iad1"],
  "env": {
    "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL": "@supabase-url",
    "NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY": "@supabase-anon-key"
  }
}
```

#### `stripe`
- Webhook handler at `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts`
- Service: `src/server/services/billing/stripe.service.ts`

#### `resend`
- Service: `src/server/services/email/resend.service.ts`
- Templates: `welcome` · `password-reset` · `invoice`

#### `posthog`
- Client wrapper: `src/lib/analytics.ts`
- Provider injected into root layout

#### `sentry`
- `sentry.client.config.ts` · `sentry.server.config.ts`
- Error boundary in root layout

#### `aws`
- CDK stack at `infra/` with: S3 · CloudFront · Secrets Manager

#### `clerk`
- Replace Supabase auth with Clerk provider
- Middleware: `src/middleware.ts` with `authMiddleware`

### Phase 7 — Environment file

Generate `.env.example` covering every configured service. Copy to `.env.local` with placeholder values. Never write real secrets.

### Phase 9 — Validation

```bash
pnpm ai:check
pnpm run check:tokens
pnpm type-check       # tsc --noEmit
pnpm build            # must exit 0
```

Checklist:
- [ ] All archetype pages generated and spec'd
- [ ] Navigation YAML complete
- [ ] All `--services` configured
- [ ] `.env.example` covers every key
- [ ] Prisma schema parses (`prisma validate`)
- [ ] No TypeScript errors
- [ ] Build passes

### Phase 10 — Handoff

Append to `HANDOFF_QUEUE.yaml`:

```yaml
- id: arch-handoff-<uid>
  from: swarm-1
  to: swarm-3
  status: pending
  created_at: <iso-timestamp>
  context:
    archetype: <type>
    pages_generated: <n>
    services_configured: [<list>]
  next_command: /DEVELOP
```

## Error handling

| Error | Action |
|-------|--------|
| PRD missing | Block — suggest `/START prd` |
| DESIGN.md not applied | Block — suggest `/START design` |
| Phase gate failed | Block — suggest `/START gates` |
| Service config error | Log to `docs/reports/errors/` · escalate to relevant lead agent |
| Build fails after scaffold | Log · suggest `/FIX archetype` |
